connector_materialization.source_bytes: The complete decoded UTF-8 content returned by GitHub fetch_file/API responses for the exact requested path and rules_source_sha is the canonical file content.
connector_materialization.preferred_fetch: Fetch the complete file in one response when possible.

chunked_fetch_fallback.trigger: Use when a connector/UI response is truncated, clipped or elided because the file is large.
chunked_fetch_fallback.method: Refetch the same path and exact rules_source_sha with explicit non-overlapping start_line/end_line ranges until every source line has been obtained, then concatenate ranges in ascending order preserving original newline boundaries.
prohibited: retyping or reconstructing from a truncated visible excerpt
treating one truncated presentation response as source unavailability

blob_verification.expected_sha_source: GitHub connector fetch_file blob sha for the exact path/ref
blob_verification.failure_rule: Fail closed if reconstructed bytes do not match the connector-returned Git blob SHA.

connector_materialization.write_rule: ChatGPT/Work must create parent directories and write the complete verified connector-returned content directly to an ordinary local/container file at the same repository-relative path under the temporary materialization root.
connector_materialization.failure_rule: Do not treat response truncation, absence of an automatic connector filesystem mount, connector file reference, repository archive, checkout or special materialization bridge as a blocker when exact line-ranged fetches remain available. Fail closed only when required source ranges cannot be fetched, reconstructed bytes fail blob verification, bytes cannot be written, or a required Python entrypoint fails after writing.

source_rule: Fetch every required_python_files and required_data_files path directly from the exact rules_source_sha using the GitHub API/connector. Use a single complete response when possible; otherwise use verified line-ranged fetches from the same path/ref and reconstruct the file exactly. Treat the complete verified decoded UTF-8 content as the source bytes and write it to an ordinary local file preserving repository-relative paths. No automatic connector filesystem mount, special bridge, repository archive, checkout, .git directory, Git executable or GitHub Actions planner job is required.

planner_state_placeholders.rule: For the explicit existence/uniqueness checks below, materialize zero-byte placeholder files for matching canonical repository paths. Their contents are not read by those checks.
